enrollment.descriptionAddFamilyMember: Create a profile you own and generate a dedicated persisted plan.
enrollment.stepDetailsDescription: So we can calculate your plan.
enrollment.stepBodyDescription: A couple more numbers to personalize your plan.
enrollment.errorBirthdateInvalid: Birthdate must be a valid date.
enrollment.errorMustBeAdult: User must be at least 18 years old.
enrollment.errorHeightRange: Height must be between 140 and 210 cm.
enrollment.errorWeightRange: Weight must be between 50 and 150 kg.
riskProfile.heading: Tell us more about your health
riskProfile.description: Optional — a few of your plan items depend on personal risk factors. Skip this and add it later from your profile if you'd rather not answer now.
riskProfile.question: Do any of these apply to you?
riskProfile.smoker: I currently smoke, or quit smoking within the last 10 years
riskProfile.sti: I have multiple sexual partners, or have had a sexually transmitted infection
riskProfile.hiv: I have a personal risk factor for HIV
riskProfile.hepatitisB: I was born (or my parents were born) in a region with higher hepatitis B prevalence
riskProfile.cardiovascularChronic: I have a chronic heart condition (e.g. heart failure, prior stroke, treatment-resistant hypertension)
riskProfile.pulmonaryChronic: I have a chronic lung condition (e.g. COPD, severe asthma, bronchiectasis)
riskProfile.chronicLiverDisease: I have chronic liver disease or cirrhosis
riskProfile.chronicKidneyDisease: I have chronic kidney disease or nephrotic syndrome
riskProfile.diabetesWithOrganImpact: I have diabetes affecting my heart, lungs, or kidneys
riskProfile.asplenia: I don't have a functioning spleen (anatomical or functional asplenia)
riskProfile.hematologicMalignancy: I have or have had lymphoma, leukemia, or myeloma
riskProfile.activeChemotherapy: I'm currently on active chemotherapy or radiotherapy for a tumor
riskProfile.transplantCandidateOrRecipie: I'm on a transplant waiting list, or have had an organ or stem-cell transplant
riskProfile.immunosuppressiveMedication: I take medication that suppresses my immune system
riskProfile.congenitalImmunodeficiency: I have a congenital immune deficiency
riskProfile.cochlearImplantOrCsfLeak: I have a cochlear implant or a cerebrospinal fluid leak
riskProfile.postpartumUnvaccinated: I recently gave birth and wasn't vaccinated during pregnancy
riskProfile.pretermOrLowBirthweight: My child was born preterm or with low birth weight
riskProfile.labPersonnelPathogenExposure: I work in a laboratory with pathogen exposure risk
riskProfile.closeContactInfantUnder6mo: I'm in regular close contact with an infant under 6 months
riskProfile.msm: I'm a man who has sex with men
riskProfile.incarceratedOrCorrectionalSt: I'm currently incarcerated, or work in a correctional facility
riskProfile.highEndemicityHepbOriginOrTr: I was born in, or regularly travel to, a region with higher hepatitis B/A prevalence
riskProfile.tbeRiskAreaExposure: I live in or regularly visit a tick-borne encephalitis risk area
riskProfile.animalOrBatOccupationalConta: My work or hobbies involve regular contact with animals or bats
riskProfile.highTbIncidenceCountryExposu: I (or my child) have regular exposure to a country with high tuberculosis incidence
